**Findings for Alpha, by severity** (full text at notes §3):

- **F1, adjudication needed.** The design file supersedes itself and the spec follows neither. `plan-combinatorics-and-categories.md` L4668 and L5321 carry **CB-6 (ENRICHED)** and **CB-13 (ENRICHED)**, which supersede the §11 sections my dispatch names, and L50 splits CB-13 into CB-13 + **CB-23** (Combinatorial Nullstellensatz) + **CB-24** (polynomial spaces). `plan-spec.json` has neither new page. I followed the spec and built the Nullstellensatz block on `linear-algebra-methods-in-combinatorics`, because a `deferred` disposition may not name a page id that does not resolve. Declining costs nine items and the page's polynomial-method half. The spec-vs-design divergence itself is stage 1's `drift` unit's, not mine.
- **F3.** The enriched CB-13 states `inner-product-spaces-and-orthogonality` "carries 0 items". It carries 34 published items; the scaffold cites them. Exact applyable edit at notes §9.
- **F4.** LGV kept here, reversing §11 per the enriched CB-6. Four items.
- **F5.** The second Nullstellensatz application is Alon–Füredi's cube cover, not a graph-colouring corollary — Alon–Tarsi needs orientations and choosability the library lacks.
- **F6.** The general inclusion-matrix rank theorem is **not** built. I worked the block-triangular induction: it loses one unit of range per step and proves nothing new, and the boundary case is the disjointness-matrix nonsingularity. Only `t = 1` is scaffolded, and a Remark says so rather than stating a theorem the page lacks.
- **F7.** The nonuniform Ray-Chaudhuri–Wilson bound is built here despite the enriched design routing it to the non-existent CB-24; the multilinear machinery also supplies the second Sauer–Shelah proof.
- **F8.** `finite-probability-and-the-probabilistic-method` is a declared prerequisite of A223 with **no load-bearing edge**. I looked for a seam and found none I could build without inventing a claim. Alpha's call; I would not mint one.
- **F9.** Two source URLs are recorded as Wayback snapshots — Uchicago fails certificate validation from here, Charles University times out under the gate fetcher while `curl` succeeds. Both snapshots serve identical byte counts; canonical links kept in `original_url`.
- **F10.** Chung–Feller, Narayana and non-crossing partitions declined with reasons; nine items of headroom remain on A197 if Alpha wants them.

**Forward references:** one, orientation-only, `rem-binary-trees-...` into `trees-forests-and-spanning-trees` (209 > 197). **Cross-batch dependencies:** none in either direction, checked against all ten batch manifests. **Provenance:** every published dependency was opened; none is `ai-generated`, none is legacy-unclassified, so no confidence route was owed. Nineteen items are `ai-generated`, all examples or counterexamples, none a `deps` target.

**Not verified, flagged in notes §7:** the collision witness in `cex-a-map-between-two-catalan-families-that-is-not-injective` is an obligation, not a computation; the degenerate two-vertex polygon at the base of the triangulation recursion is a convention I fixed by fiat; the odd-`n` case of `thm-every-maximal-eventown-family-is-maximum` I reasoned through and checked at `n = 3` but did not write out.
